name: Artificial Creation
author: rrenaud; card concept by u/Suspicious_Badger_18
description: Adds Artificial Creation, a rare Defect skill: gain 10 Block and Channel 2 Glass, Innate in multi-enemy fights. Costs 2 energy, or 1 when upgraded.
